# Sheaf

Sheaf is a third-party execution recorder for AI agents. It captures MCP tool
calls at the proxy boundary, signs each event outside the agent process with
Ed25519, hash-chains the events, batches them into Merkle epochs, and anchors
epoch roots on Base L2. A `.sheaf` bundle can be verified offline without
trusting Sheaf's servers.

Canonical site: https://sheafhq.io/
Verifier: https://sheafhq.io/verify
GitHub: https://github.com/sheafhq/sheaf
Technical whitepaper: https://sheafhq.io/whitepaper

## NPM packages

- `@sheafhq/mcp-recorder` — MCP stdio proxy and local firewall/ledger.
  Binary: `sheaf-mcp-recorder`
- `@sheafhq/verify` — zero-dependency verifier for receipts and Dispute Bundles.
  Binary: `sheaf-verify`
- `@sheafhq/mcp-tools` — MCP server exposing `sheaf_chain_head`,
  `sheaf_get_proof_for`, and `sheaf_verify_bundle`.
  Binary: `sheaf-mcp-tools`
- `packages/s3-gateway` in the repo — S3-compatible PUT gateway that records
  `s3.put` receipts. It is not published as an npm package yet.

## Install and wrap an MCP server

```bash
npm install -g @sheafhq/mcp-recorder
export SHEAF_CHAIN_ID="my-agent-production"
sheaf-mcp-recorder --wrap npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem .
```

Remote mode sends signed events to `https://api.sheafhq.io`. Set
`SHEAF_RECORDER_URL` to use a different recorder. For local-only mode:

```bash
sheaf-mcp-recorder wrap --local \
  --policy ./policy.json \
  --chain-dir ./.sheaf \
  --case ./case.json \
  -- npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem .
```

Local mode writes `.sheaf/local-keys.json` (mode 0600) and an append-only
`.sheaf/ledger.jsonl`. It makes no HTTP requests. Blocked policy calls return a
JSON-RPC error with code `-32001` and write a `result: "blocked"` event.

## Export and verify a local ledger

```bash
sheaf local export --chain-dir ./.sheaf --case ./case.json --out bundle.sheaf
sheaf local sync --chain-dir ./.sheaf
sheaf dispute verify bundle.sheaf --rpc https://mainnet.base.org --trust ./.sheaf/trust.json
```

`local sync` posts a signed root request to `POST /v1/anchor/local`. Once
anchored, the next `local export` includes the Base transaction and
`anchor_mode: base`.

## Verify a remote receipt

```bash
npm install -g @sheafhq/verify
sheaf-verify receipt.json --rpc https://mainnet.base.org
```

Or use the library:

```ts
import { verify } from "@sheafhq/verify";
const result = await verify(bundle, {
  base_rpc: "https://mainnet.base.org",
  recorder_public_key_base64: "3HAltFwtHSZp83CLKYF/KKG2Ac4Se/YiD+AkfqCb+e8=",
  expected_anchorer_address: "0x08A22c6899a8b2eccA4b2B752a89eD498d7b2100",
});
```

## x402 paid endpoints

Heavy endpoints return HTTP 402 with a `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header when called
without payment. Pay in USDC on Base and retry with the x402 payment header.

| Method | Path | Price |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/bundle/:chain_id/:seq` | $0.001 |
| `POST` | `/v1/anchor/local` | $0.01 |
| `POST` | `/v1/chains/:chain_id/export` | $0.01 |

Autonomous agents can use the payer helper in `@sheafhq/mcp-recorder`:

```ts
import { createX402Payer, paidFetch } from "@sheafhq/mcp-recorder";
const payer = createX402Payer(process.env.SHEAF_PAYER_PRIVATE_KEY!);
const response = await paidFetch(
  "https://sheafhq.io/v1/chains/my-chain/export",
  { method: "POST", headers: { "content-type": "application/json" }, body: "{}" },
  payer,
);
```

The helper parses `PAYMENT-REQUIRED`, signs the exact EIP-3009 authorization
with a local viem account, and retries. A funded Base wallet with USDC is
required.

## Get an API key

`POST https://sheafhq.io/v1/checkout` returns a Stripe Checkout URL for Sheaf
Pro. After `checkout.session.completed`, the Worker generates an API key and
emails it to the customer. If Stripe or email is not configured, the endpoint
returns a structured `stripe_not_configured` / delivery-queued response rather
than a fake checkout URL.

## Machine-readable manifest

`GET https://sheafhq.io/manifest` lists free and paid endpoints, payment
metadata, and current recorder key IDs.
